profile.description: Recommended low-TTFA server configuration for a 16-core Google Axion host. Every value was read from the qualification harness and the engine source, not from memory.

hardware.notes: GCP c4a-standard-16, no SMT. SVE/SVE2 are present at 128-bit but the engine has no SVE kernel path today.

requirements.kleidiai: vendored subset of ARM-software/kleidiai 495f652; SMMLA and BFMMLA both compiled and active
requirements.note: GIT_REV must be passed on the command line: a synced tree has no .git, so the binary cannot certify its own commit.

server.worker_affinity: contiguous core slices, worker 0 -> CPU 0-7, worker 1 -> CPU 8-15

precision.speech_decoder_weights: fp32 - QWEN_SD_INT8 is off by default and int4 measured slower on the first frame
precision.activations: fp32; int8 activations are quantized per call inside the int8 kernels
precision.gemm_backend: KleidiAI BFMMLA for bf16 matmat, SMMLA for int8 matmat, OpenBLAS sgemm for the speech decoder convolutions

OPENBLAS_THREAD_TIMEOUT.why: runtime production recommendation; without it OpenBLAS idles by spinning on sched_yield and steals from the other worker

OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS.why: deliberately not set - OpenBLAS picks its own within the worker's core slice

QWEN_PREFIX_CACHE.why: reuses the request-independent prompt head; measured 9 of 13-79 positions on the production prompts

QWEN_SERVE_PROFILE.why: diagnostics; counters and timing never share a binary in a run that produces a number
QWEN_SERVE_PROFILE.revert: QWEN_SERVE_PROFILE=1 for the driver phase table

qualification.workload: REALISTIC - a mixed-length text bank, 21 texts, audio p50 3.84 s per request. Short-text banks are an engineering inner loop and never a production figure.
qualification.speaker: ryan
qualification.notes: preferred_concurrency is 4 because at C=6 the realtime factor measured ~1.1: first audio still good, sustained realtime not. The band claims nothing above C=8. Topology and thread split were qualified on this host; the model named here is the base checkpoint the profile is exercised against, and a profile makes no claim about any particular checkpoint's audio.
